inputs.dinov3_decision: fine-tuned DINOv3 epoch_018 benchmark policy decision: FAKE, REVIEW or AUTHENTIC (Triton, as in benchmark_v1)
inputs.p71: Phase 71 probe P(fake): frozen pretrained DINOv3 ViT-B/16 + logistic head (generator_agnostic_v1/dinov3_vitb16_linear.joblib), image through the Phase 71 base + clean view
inputs.brand_text: true when RapidOCR (literal reader, line confidence >= 0.6) reads a word containing one of the declared brand's words: LANGE/SOHNE/GLASHUTTE, AUDEMARS/PIGUET, PATEK/PHILIPPE, RICHARD/MILLE, VACHERON/CONSTANTIN. Gemma 4 readings are recorded but not used: on development data its 'other brand' answers were guesses on unreadable dials.

thresholds.T71_source: Phase 71 protocol: 99th percentile of P(fake) on Label_0 validation photos
thresholds.t_low_source: Label_0 validation real photos only: the lowest grid value at which photos without brand text and t_low <= p71 < T71 are at most 2% of all 1,000 photos. No generated image was used.

decision: FAKE if dinov3_decision == FAKE, or p71 >= T71, or (not brand_text and p71 >= t_low). Otherwise REVIEW if dinov3_decision == REVIEW, else AUTHENTIC.
rejected_variant: fusion_B (also FAKE when not brand_text and dinov3_decision == REVIEW) rejected 14/300 real eBay development photos (4.7%), above the protocol's 3-point limit.
